data_fields.name: inventory_slots
data_fields.donor_constant: per inventory type from InvType.size (default 1 at InvType.ts:73; per-type values not read)

data_fields.name: stack_merge_on_drop
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: stackable, same receiver, same tile, total within stack limit; merge resets lifetime to new duration

best_idea: A bag whose add returns how many units fit, a move that checks the target before removing from the source, and a leftover that becomes a ground drop owned by the player and revealed to everyone after a delay.
decision_why: Keep the container, stack modes and owner-only reveal; change the move to check-then-move because the donor removes first and drops overflow to the floor, which breaks the one-ledger ruling and has a phantom-drop defect (D2).
acceptance: A player with one free slot and 40 stackable arrows moves 40, sees 'Bag full: 12 left' and may drop them, visible only to them for 60 s; a server test asserts moved + overflow + missing == requested and that no move raises an item's total.
